mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.2% compresses equity discount rates, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days without regime dependence.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS below 0.2% for 3 consecutive months but S&P 500 20-day returns negative in 60%+ of periods.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 5.0% over three months signals economic weakness, triggering negative S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE > 5.0% for 3 months but S&P 500 5-day returns positive in 60%+ of instances.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and retail sales indicate collapsing consumer demand, producing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST and RSAFS both decline for 2 months but S&P 500 60-day returns positive in 60%+ of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production below 100 (2017=100) during supply chain disruptions causes negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO < 100 but S&P 500 20-day returns positive in 60%+ of periods.

mechanism_narrative: Quarterly GDP growth above 2.0% indicates robust economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: GDPC1 > 2.0% for latest quarter but S&P 500 5-day returns negative in 60%+ of cases.

mechanism_narrative: CPI inflation exceeding 3.0% prompts rate hike expectations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL > 3.0 but S&P 500 60-day returns positive in 60%+ of periods.

mechanism_narrative: High unemployment (UNRATE > 5.0%) combined with stagnant Fed rates (FEDFUNDS unchanged) signals policy inaction during labor weakness, yielding negative returns over 20 days.
regime_hint: labor market weakness with no monetary easing
failure_condition: UNRATE > 5.0% and FEDFUNDS unchanged but S&P 500 20-day returns positive in 60%+ of instances.

mechanism_narrative: Slowing industrial production growth (INDPRO YoY < 1.0%) forecasts economic deceleration, generating negative S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO growth rate < 1.0% YoY but S&P 500 5-day returns positive in 60%+ of cases.
